tool_schemas.name: smartlead_create_campaign
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new outbound email campaign owned by the given client, optionally initializing its settings, schedule, and sequence steps, and returns the created campaign record (including its generated campaign_id). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, IDs don’t match the required patterns, or unknown properties are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if client_id does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to create campaigns for the client, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the client/account has reached its campaign limit.

client_id.description: Client ID that will own the campaign.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_update_campaign_schedule
tool_schemas.description: Replaces the schedule object for an existing campaign and returns the updated campaign record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id is malformed, schedule is missing/invalid, or unknown properties are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the campaign does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the campaign, and CONFLICT if the campaign is in a terminal state (deleted) where updates are refused.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID to update.

schedule.description: Campaign schedule settings object to set/replace.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_update_campaign_settings
tool_schemas.description: Replaces the campaign’s general settings object and returns the updated campaign record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id is malformed, settings is missing/invalid, or unknown properties are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the campaign does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the campaign, and CONFLICT if the campaign is deleted and cannot be modified.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID to update.

settings.description: Campaign general settings object to set/replace.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_update_campaign_status
tool_schemas.description: Changes a campaign’s status to one of: draft, active, paused, completed, archived, or deleted, and returns the updated campaign record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id is malformed, status is not one of the allowed values, or unknown properties are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the campaign does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the campaign, and CONFLICT when the requested transition is not allowed (for example, attempting to modify a deleted campaign or moving from a terminal status in a way the system refuses).

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID to update.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_campaign
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full details for a single campaign by campaign_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id is malformed or unknown properties are provided, and NOT_FOUND if no campaign exists with that ID. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the campaign.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_list_campaigns
tool_schemas.description: Lists campaigns you have access to, optionally filtered by client_id, status, and name search, and returns a page of results sorted by sort_by/sort_order; pagination uses limit and an opaque cursor, and the response includes a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter/sort field is invalid, limit is out of range, cursor is malformed, or unknown properties are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if client_id is supplied but does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to list campaigns for the requested client.

client_id.description: Filter campaigns by owning client ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_save_campaign_sequence
tool_schemas.description: Replaces the entire sequence_steps array for the given campaign and returns the updated sequence as stored for that campaign. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id is malformed, sequence_steps is missing/invalid, or unknown properties are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the campaign does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the campaign, and CONFLICT if the campaign is deleted and sequence updates are refused.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID whose sequence will be saved.

sequence_steps.description: Full sequence steps array to set/replace for the campaign.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_campaign_sequence
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current sequence steps for a campaign. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id is malformed or unknown properties are provided, and NOT_FOUND if the campaign does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the campaign.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID whose sequence will be fetched.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_campaigns_by_lead
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of campaigns that include the specified lead, optionally including archived/deleted campaigns when include_deleted=true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if lead_id is malformed or unknown properties are provided, and NOT_FOUND if the lead does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the lead or to one or more campaigns in the result set.

lead_id.description: Lead ID to fetch campaign memberships for.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include campaigns with status=deleted/archived.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_export_campaign_leads
tool_schemas.description: Exports leads from a campaign in CSV-compatible chunks and returns a page of lead rows for the requested campaign/status filter; use limit and the opaque cursor to page through the export until no next cursor is returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id is malformed, status is not one of the allowed values, limit is out of range, cursor is malformed, or unknown properties are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the campaign does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the campaign, and CONFLICT if the campaign is deleted and lead export is refused.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID to export leads from.

status.description: Filter exported leads by lead status.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for exporting in chunks.

limit.description: Maximum number of leads to include per export chunk.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_delete_campaign
tool_schemas.description: Permanently deletes the specified campaign and returns a confirmation of deletion. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the campaign does not exist or is not accessible to your client, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to delete it. Raises CONFLICT if the campaign is in a non-deletable state (e.g., currently running or otherwise locked) and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID to permanently delete.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_campaign_analytics_by_date
tool_schemas.description: Returns aggregated analytics for the given campaign for the inclusive date range from start_date to end_date. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id is invalid, dates are missing/invalid, or start_date is after end_date, and NOT_FOUND if the campaign does not exist or is not accessible. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to view analytics for the campaign and RATE_LIMITED when analytics access limits are exceeded.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID to fetch analytics for.

start_date.description: Start date (inclusive) for the analytics range (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.description: End date (inclusive) for the analytics range (YYYY-MM-DD).

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_campaign_sequence_analytics
tool_schemas.description: Returns analytics scoped to a single sequence step (1-based) within the specified campaign. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id is invalid or sequence_step is missing/out of range, and NOT_FOUND if the campaign does not exist or the requested sequence step does not exist for that campaign. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to view the campaign and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID that owns the sequence.

sequence_step.description: 1-based sequence step number to fetch analytics for.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_list_leads
tool_schemas.description: Lists leads owned by the specified client, optionally filtered by campaign_id, status, and free-text query q, and returns results sorted by sort_by/sort_order. Results are paginated with cursor-based pagination: pass cursor from the previous response to fetch the next page, and limit controls page size (1–200). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters (including unknown enums or invalid IDs), NOT_FOUND if the referenced client or campaign does not exist/is not accessible, FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to list the client’s leads, and RATE_LIMITED when listing quotas are exceeded.

client_id.description: Client ID whose leads should be listed.

campaign_id.description: Filter leads to those belonging to the specified campaign.

q.description: Free-text search across common lead fields (e.g., email/name/company).

limit.description: Maximum number of leads to return.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_lead
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full lead record for the specified lead_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if lead_id is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the lead does not exist or is not accessible to your client, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to view it. Raises RATE_LIMITED when read quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_add_lead_to_campaign
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new lead owned by lead.client_id and associates it to the specified campaign, returning the created lead (and its campaign association). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id is invalid, required lead fields (client_id, email) are missing/invalid, or provided fields fail validation, and NOT_FOUND if the campaign or client does not exist/is not accessible. Raises CONFLICT if the lead email already exists where uniqueness rules apply or the campaign cannot accept new leads in its current state, FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to modify the campaign/client, and RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID to add the lead to.

client_id.description: Client ID that will own the lead record.

custom_fields.description: Arbitrary custom fields for the lead.

lead.description: Lead fields to create and associate to the campaign.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_update_lead
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable lead fields (including custom_fields) for the specified lead_id and returns the updated lead. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if lead_id is invalid or any provided fields are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the lead does not exist or is not accessible, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to edit the lead. Raises CONFLICT if the update would violate uniqueness/consistency constraints (e.g., changing email to a value that already exists where uniqueness rules apply) and RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

lead_id.description: Unique identifier of the lead to update.

custom_fields.description: Arbitrary key/value custom fields for the lead.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_update_lead_status
tool_schemas.description: Updates a lead’s status to one of active, suppressed, or deleted and returns the updated lead. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if lead_id is invalid or status is not one of the allowed values, NOT_FOUND if the lead does not exist or is not accessible, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to change it. Raises CONFLICT if the requested status transition is not allowed for the lead’s current state and RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

lead_id.description: Unique identifier of the lead to update.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_bulk_import_leads
tool_schemas.description: Imports multiple leads into the specified campaign and returns an import result summarizing created/updated/skipped records for the batch. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if campaign_id is invalid, leads is empty/invalid, or any lead item is missing required fields (email) or fails validation, and NOT_FOUND if the campaign does not exist or is not accessible. Raises CONFLICT when one or more leads conflict with existing records under applicable uniqueness rules or the campaign cannot accept imports in its current state, FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to modify the campaign, and RATE_LIMITED when import quotas are exceeded.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identifier to import leads into.

custom_fields.description: Arbitrary key/value custom fields for the lead.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_delete_lead
tool_schemas.description: Permanently deletes the specified lead and returns a confirmation of deletion. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if lead_id is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the lead does not exist or is not accessible, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to delete it. Raises CONFLICT if the lead cannot be deleted due to its current state or active associations that must be removed first, and RATE_LIMITED when delete quotas are exceeded.

lead_id.description: Unique identifier of the lead to delete.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_campaign_statistics
tool_schemas.description: Returns aggregated email-level statistics for the specified campaign, optionally filtered by email_status, sent_time_start_date/sent_time_end_date (inclusive), and/or email_sequence_number. The response contains summary counts/metrics for the matching emails and is not paginated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when campaign_id does not match the required format, date bounds are invalid (e.g., start after end), or email_sequence_number is < 1; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when you don’t have access to the campaign; raises NOT_FOUND when the campaign_id does not exist.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identifier to fetch statistics for.

email_status.description: Optional email status filter used when aggregating campaign email statistics.

sent_time_start_date.description: Start of sent-time window (inclusive) for filtering statistics.

sent_time_end_date.description: End of sent-time window (inclusive) for filtering statistics.

email_sequence_number.description: Optional sequence step number to filter statistics by.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_campaign_statistics_by_date
tool_schemas.description: Returns aggregated campaign statistics for the given campaign_id over the inclusive date window [start_date, end_date]. The response contains summary counts/metrics for the period and is not paginated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when campaign_id is malformed, dates are not valid YYYY-MM-DD, or start_date is after end_date; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when you lack access to the campaign; raises NOT_FOUND when the campaign does not exist.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identifier to fetch statistics for.

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the statistics window.

end_date.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the statistics window.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_warmup_stats_by_email
tool_schemas.description: Returns the last 7 days of warmup statistics for the specified email account. The response contains the daily warmup metrics for that mailbox and is not paginated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when email is missing/invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the mailbox is not accessible to your workspace; raises NOT_FOUND when the email account is unknown to Smartlead.

email.description: Email account address to fetch warmup stats for.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_campaign_top_level_analytics
tool_schemas.description: Returns top-level analytics totals for the specified campaign across the default reporting window used by Smartlead. The response is a single analytics summary object and is not paginated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when campaign_id is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when you don’t have access to the campaign; raises NOT_FOUND when the campaign does not exist.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identifier to fetch top-level analytics for.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_campaign_top_level_analytics_by_date
tool_schemas.description: Returns top-level analytics totals for the specified campaign over the inclusive date range [start_date, end_date]. The response is a single analytics summary object and is not paginated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when campaign_id is malformed, dates are not valid YYYY-MM-DD, or start_date is after end_date; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when you don’t have access to the campaign; raises NOT_FOUND when the campaign does not exist.

campaign_id.description: Smartlead campaign ID to fetch analytics for.

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the analytics range, inclusive.

end_date.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the analytics range, inclusive.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_campaign_lead_statistics
tool_schemas.description: Returns aggregated lead statistics for the specified campaign (lead-level counts/metrics as reported by Smartlead). The response is a single summary payload and is not paginated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when campaign_id is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when you don’t have access to the campaign; raises NOT_FOUND when the campaign does not exist.

campaign_id.description: Smartlead campaign ID to fetch lead statistics for.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_campaign_mailbox_statistics
tool_schemas.description: Returns aggregated mailbox statistics for the specified campaign (mailbox-level counts/metrics for sending activity). The response is a single summary payload and is not paginated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when campaign_id is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when you don’t have access to the campaign; raises NOT_FOUND when the campaign does not exist.

campaign_id.description: Smartlead campaign ID to fetch mailbox statistics for.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_download_campaign_data
tool_schemas.description: Generates and returns a downloadable campaign data export for the specified campaign and records the download event for reporting. The response provides the export result (including any link/identifier returned by Smartlead) and is not paginated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when campaign_id is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when you don’t have export permission for the campaign; raises NOT_FOUND when the campaign does not exist.

campaign_id.description: Smartlead campaign ID to download data for.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_view_download_statistics
tool_schemas.description: Returns statistics for campaign data downloads for the specified campaign (e.g., counts/recency as tracked by Smartlead). The response is a single summary payload and is not paginated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when campaign_id is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when you don’t have access to the campaign’s analytics; raises NOT_FOUND when the campaign does not exist.

campaign_id.description: Smartlead campaign ID to view download statistics for.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_region_wise_providers
tool_schemas.description: Returns the catalog of email provider IDs available for spam testing, grouped by region/country, for use when creating manual or automated spam tests. The response is a full list (not paginated). Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key cannot access provider catalogs for your workspace, and may raise RATE_LIMITED when you exceed request limits.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_create_manual_placement_test
tool_schemas.description: Creates a manual Smart Delivery placement test under the given folder for the given client using the specified providers, sender accounts, receiver mailboxes, and email definitions, and returns the newly created test record (including its test_id and initial status). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any required field is missing, IDs do not match the expected format, providers is empty, or payload contains unknown properties; raises NOT_FOUND if the client_id or folder_id does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to create tests for the client/folder and RATE_LIMITED if Smart Delivery creation limits are exceeded.

client_id.description: Client ID that will own the Smart Delivery test.

folder_id.description: Smart Delivery folder ID to organize the test under.

name.description: Human-readable name for the manual placement test.

providers.description: List of email provider identifiers (as returned by region-wise providers) to include in the test.

sender_accounts.description: Sender account configuration(s) used to send test emails.

items.description: Sender account object for the test.

receiver_mailboxes.description: Receiver mailbox configuration(s) where the test emails will land for placement checks.

items.description: Receiver mailbox object for the test.

emails.description: Email content definitions to be used for the placement test.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_create_automated_placement_test
tool_schemas.description: Creates an automated Smart Delivery placement test with a schedule under the given folder for the given client, and returns the created test record (including its test_id and initial status/schedule). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if schedule is missing/invalid, any required field is missing, IDs do not match the expected format, providers is empty, or payload contains unknown properties; raises NOT_FOUND if the client_id or folder_id does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to create tests for the client/folder and RATE_LIMITED if automated test limits are exceeded.

client_id.description: Client ID that will own the Smart Delivery test.

folder_id.description: Smart Delivery folder ID to organize the test under.

name.description: Human-readable name for the automated placement test.

schedule.description: Schedule configuration describing when and how often the automated test runs.

providers.description: List of email provider identifiers (as returned by region-wise providers) to include in the test.

sender_accounts.description: Sender account configuration(s) used to send test emails.

items.description: Sender account object for the test.

receiver_mailboxes.description: Receiver mailbox configuration(s) where the test emails will land for placement checks.

items.description: Receiver mailbox object for the test.

emails.description: Email content definitions to be used for the automated placement test.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_spam_test_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full details for a single Smart Delivery test identified by test_id (manual or automated), including its configuration and current status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if test_id does not match the required format. Raises NOT_FOUND if the test does not exist or you do not have access to it, and FORBIDDEN if access to the owning client/folder is not permitted.

test_id.description: Smart Delivery test ID to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_delete_smart_delivery_tests
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the Smart Delivery tests identified by test_ids and returns a bulk deletion result indicating which tests were deleted and which could not be processed. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if test_ids is empty, contains duplicates, or any test_id is not in the required format. Raises NOT_FOUND for any test_id that does not exist or is not accessible to you, and CONFLICT if a test cannot be deleted due to its current state (for example, an actively running automated test).

test_ids.description: List of Smart Delivery test IDs to delete.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_stop_automated_test
tool_schemas.description: Stops an automated Smart Delivery test early and returns the updated test record reflecting its stopped status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if test_id is not in the required format. Raises NOT_FOUND if the test does not exist or is not accessible to you, and CONFLICT if the test is not an automated test or is not in a stoppable state (for example, already stopped or completed).

test_id.description: Automated Smart Delivery test ID to stop.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_list_all_tests
tool_schemas.description: Lists Smart Delivery tests (manual and/or automated) matching the provided filters and returns up to limit results sorted by sort_by/sort_order; when more results exist, the response includes a cursor to fetch the next page by passing it back. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter value is invalid (including unsupported enums), IDs do not match the expected format, or limit is out of range. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to list tests for the requested client_id/folder_id, and RATE_LIMITED if listing limits are exceeded.

folder_id.description: Filter tests by Smart Delivery folder ID.

client_id.description: Filter tests by client ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of tests to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_provider_wise_report
tool_schemas.description: Returns the provider-wise report for the specified Smart Delivery test, grouped and summarized by email provider. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if test_id does not match the required format. Raises NOT_FOUND if the test does not exist or is not accessible to you, and CONFLICT if the report is not available because the test has not produced results yet (for example, still draft/scheduled/running).

test_id.description: Smart Delivery test ID to fetch provider-wise report for.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_group_wise_report
tool_schemas.description: Returns the group/location-wise report for the specified Smart Delivery test, grouped by region/country (or equivalent grouping used by Smart Delivery). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if test_id does not match the required format. Raises NOT_FOUND if the test does not exist or is not accessible to you, and CONFLICT if the report is not available because the test has not produced results yet.

test_id.description: Smart Delivery test ID to fetch location/group-wise report for.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_sender_account_wise_report
tool_schemas.description: Returns the sender-account-wise report for the specified Smart Delivery test, including per-sender mailbox details of each email where available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if test_id does not match the required format. Raises NOT_FOUND if the test does not exist or is not accessible to you, and CONFLICT if the report is not available because the test has not produced results yet.

test_id.description: Smart Delivery test ID to fetch sender-account-wise report for.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_spam_filter_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns spam filter details for the specified Smart Delivery test, optionally filtered to a single sender mailbox by sender_email, including spam scores and the contributing signals when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if test_id does not match the required format or sender_email is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the test does not exist or is not accessible to you, and CONFLICT if spam-filter results are not available yet or the requested sender_email has no results for this test.

test_id.description: Smart Delivery test ID to fetch spam filter details for.

sender_email.description: Filter spam filter details to a specific sender mailbox email address.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_dkim_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns DKIM authentication results for messages in a Smart Delivery test, optionally scoped to a specific run_id and/or email_id, including per-sender mailbox and per-receiver outcome details when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if test_id does not match the required format or if any provided scope identifiers are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the test (or the specified run/email within it) does not exist or is not accessible to your client, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to view the test’s deliverability data.

test_id.description: Smart Delivery test id to fetch DKIM authentication results for.

run_id.description: Specific test run identifier within the test to scope DKIM results.

email_id.description: Specific email identifier within the test/run to scope DKIM results.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_spf_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns SPF authentication results for a Smart Delivery test, optionally narrowed to a specific run_id and/or email_id, including pass/fail and any available evaluation details for the relevant messages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid test_id format or malformed scope identifiers, NOT_FOUND if the test (or the specified run/email) cannot be found or is not accessible, and FORBIDDEN when your client lacks permission to read these results.

test_id.description: Smart Delivery test id to fetch SPF authentication results for.

run_id.description: Specific test run identifier within the test to scope SPF results.

email_id.description: Specific email identifier within the test/run to scope SPF results.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_rdns_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns reverse-DNS (rDNS) validation details for sending IPs observed in a Smart Delivery test, optionally scoped by run_id, email_id, and/or a specific ip_address. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if test_id is invalid, ip_address is not a valid IP string, or scope identifiers are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the test (or specified run/email/IP context) does not exist or is not accessible, and FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to view the test’s infrastructure diagnostics.

test_id.description: Smart Delivery test id to fetch rDNS validation details for.

run_id.description: Specific test run identifier within the test to scope rDNS results.

ip_address.description: IP address to check rDNS correctness for.

email_id.description: Specific email identifier within the test/run to scope rDNS results.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_sender_accounts
tool_schemas.description: Lists the sender accounts selected/used for a given Smart Delivery test and returns the full set in a single response (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if test_id is not in the expected format, NOT_FOUND if the test does not exist or is not accessible to your client, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to view the test configuration and its sender selection.

test_id.description: Smart Delivery test id to list selected sender accounts for.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_blacklist
tool_schemas.description: Returns blacklist-hit records observed during a Smart Delivery test, optionally filtered by run_id, email_id, and/or ip_address; results are paged using limit and an opaque cursor, and the response includes the next cursor when more data is available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if test_id is invalid, limit is out of range, or filter identifiers are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the test (or specified run/email context) does not exist or is not accessible, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read blacklist diagnostics for the test.

test_id.description: Smart Delivery test id to fetch blacklist hits for.

run_id.description: Specific test run identifier within the test to scope blacklist results.

email_id.description: Specific email identifier within the test/run to scope blacklist results.

ip_address.description: Filter blacklist results to a specific sending IP address.

limit.description: Maximum number of blacklist records to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor to fetch the next page of blacklist records.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_email_content
tool_schemas.description: Returns the content for a specific email in a Smart Delivery test, including campaign/sequence context and the requested format (raw, html, or both). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if test_id is invalid, format is not one of the supported values, or email_id is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the test or email cannot be found or is not accessible, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to view message content for the test.

test_id.description: Smart Delivery test id that contains the email.

email_id.description: Email identifier within the test to fetch content for.

format.description: Which email content format to return.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_ip_analytics
tool_schemas.description: Returns IP-level analytics for a Smart Delivery test (including total blacklist counts identified), optionally scoped to a specific run_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if test_id is invalid or run_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the test (or specified run) does not exist or is not accessible, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to view the test’s analytics.

test_id.description: Smart Delivery test id to fetch IP-level analytics for.

run_id.description: Specific test run identifier within the test to scope analytics.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_email_headers
tool_schemas.description: Returns the parsed and/or raw header details for a specific email within a Smart Delivery test. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if test_id is invalid or email_id is missing/malformed, NOT_FOUND if the test or email cannot be found or is not accessible to your client, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to view headers for the test.

test_id.description: Smart Delivery test id that contains the email.

email_id.description: Email identifier within the test to fetch headers for.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_schedule_history
tool_schemas.description: Lists scheduled/run history for an automated Smart Delivery test owned by the specified client, returning summary + per-run items sorted by the requested order; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor, and the response includes the next cursor when more history is available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if client_id/test_id are not in the expected format, limit is out of range, or sort is not supported, NOT_FOUND if the client or test does not exist, is not accessible, or the test is not an automated test, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read schedule history for that client/test.

client_id.description: Client identifier that owns the Smart Delivery automated test.

test_id.description: Smart Delivery test ID (must be an automated test) to fetch schedule/run history for.

limit.description: Maximum number of runs/history items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

sort.description: Sort order for returned history items.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_ip_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns blacklist details by sending IP for the given email address within the specified client, optionally scoped to a single Smart Delivery test_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if client_id/test_id formats are invalid or email is not a valid email address, NOT_FOUND if the client does not exist or the email/test scope has no accessible matching data, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to view IP/blacklist diagnostics for the requested client.

client_id.description: Client identifier used to scope the lookup.

email.description: Email address to fetch IP blacklist details for.

test_id.description: Optional Smart Delivery test ID to scope the IP blacklist details to a specific test.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_mailbox_summary
tool_schemas.description: Returns an aggregated, paginated list of mailbox summary rows for mailboxes that have been used in Smart Delivery tests owned by the given client, optionally restricted to a folder and/or test type, sorted by the requested field; each page returns up to `limit` results and a `cursor` to fetch the next page. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `client_id`/`folder_id` format is invalid, `limit` is out of range, or `test_type`/`sort` is not supported. Raises `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if you don’t have access to the client or folder, and `NOT_FOUND` if `folder_id` is provided but does not exist for that client.

client_id.description: Client identifier that owns the Smart Delivery tests.

folder_id.description: Optional folder ID to restrict mailboxes to tests within a single Smart Delivery folder.

test_type.description: Optional test type filter for aggregating mailbox performance.

limit.description: Maximum number of mailbox summary rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of mailbox summaries.

sort.description: Sort order for mailbox summary results.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_mailbox_count
tool_schemas.description: Returns the total count of distinct mailboxes used in Smart Delivery tests owned by the given client, optionally restricted to a folder and/or test type. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if identifiers are malformed or `test_type` is not supported. Raises `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if you don’t have access to the client or folder, and `NOT_FOUND` if `folder_id` is provided but does not exist for that client.

client_id.description: Client identifier that owns the Smart Delivery tests.

folder_id.description: Optional folder ID to restrict the count to tests inside a single Smart Delivery folder.

test_type.description: Optional test type filter to count mailboxes used in manual vs automated tests.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_all_folders
tool_schemas.description: Lists Smart Delivery folders for the given client, optionally including the tests within each folder, filtered by status and sorted as requested; results are paginated with `limit` and an opaque `cursor` for the next page. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `client_id` is malformed, `limit` is out of range, or `status`/`sort` is not supported. Raises `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if you don’t have access to the client.

client_id.description: Client identifier that owns the Smart Delivery folders.

include_tests.description: Whether to include tests inside each folder in the response.

limit.description: Maximum number of folders to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of folders.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_create_folder
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Smart Delivery folder owned by the given client and returns the created folder record. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `client_id` is malformed or `name` is empty. Raises `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if you don’t have access to the client, and `CONFLICT` if a folder with the same name already exists for that client.

client_id.description: Client identifier that will own the new Smart Delivery folder.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_folder_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single Smart Delivery folder by ID for the given client, optionally including the tests within that folder. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `client_id`/`folder_id` formats are invalid. Raises `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if you don’t have access to the client or folder, and `NOT_FOUND` if the folder does not exist for that client.

client_id.description: Client identifier that owns the folder.

folder_id.description: Smart Delivery folder ID to retrieve.

include_tests.description: Whether to include tests inside the folder in the response.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_delete_folder
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified Smart Delivery folder and returns the updated folder (or deletion acknowledgement) for that client. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `client_id`/`folder_id` formats are invalid. Raises `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if you don’t have access, `NOT_FOUND` if the folder does not exist for that client, and `CONFLICT` if the folder cannot be deleted due to its current state (for example, already deleted).

client_id.description: Client identifier that owns the folder.

folder_id.description: Smart Delivery folder ID to delete.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_fetch_webhooks_by_campaign
tool_schemas.description: Lists webhooks configured for the specified campaign, optionally filtered by status; results are paginated using `limit` and `cursor`. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `campaign_id` is malformed, `limit` is out of range, or `status` is not supported. Raises `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if you don’t have access to the campaign, and `NOT_FOUND` if the campaign does not exist.

campaign_id.description: Smartlead campaign ID to fetch webhooks for.

limit.description: Maximum number of webhooks to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_upsert_campaign_webhook
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new webhook for the campaign when `webhook_id` is omitted, or updates the existing webhook when `webhook_id` is provided, returning the webhook record after the change. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if IDs are malformed, required `webhook.payload` is missing, or provided `status` is not supported. Raises `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if you don’t have access to the campaign, `NOT_FOUND` if the campaign (or the referenced webhook when updating) does not exist, and `CONFLICT` if the update is not allowed (for example, attempting to modify a deleted webhook).

campaign_id.description: Smartlead campaign ID that owns the webhook.

webhook_id.description: Existing webhook record ID to update; omit to create a new webhook.

webhook.description: Webhook fields to create or update for the campaign.

payload.description: Webhook configuration payload (e.g., endpoint URL, event subscriptions, auth headers).

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_delete_campaign_webhook
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified webhook from the given campaign and returns a deletion acknowledgement (or the webhook marked deleted). Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `campaign_id`/`webhook_id` formats are invalid. Raises `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if you don’t have access, `NOT_FOUND` if the campaign or webhook does not exist, and `CONFLICT` if the webhook is already deleted or cannot transition to deleted from its current state.

campaign_id.description: Smartlead campaign ID that owns the webhook.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_webhooks_publish_summary
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated summary window of webhook publish events for the given client (Private Beta), optionally scoped to a campaign and filtered by delivery status and created-at range; each page returns up to `limit` events and a `cursor` for the next window. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if IDs are malformed, `created_from`/`created_to` are invalid or reversed, `limit` is out of range, or `status` is not supported. Raises `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if you don’t have access to the client/campaign or the feature is not enabled for your account, and `NOT_FOUND` if a provided `campaign_id` does not exist under the client.

client_id.description: Client ID to scope the publish summary to.

campaign_id.description: Optional campaign ID to scope the publish summary to a single campaign.

status.description: Filter publish events by delivery status.

created_from.description: Only include publish events created at or after this timestamp.

created_to.description: Only include publish events created at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of publish-event records to include in the summary response window.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page/window.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_retrigger_failed_events
tool_schemas.description: Retriggers previously failed webhook publish attempts for the specified client and returns a summary of the records selected and re-queued; you can target specific event_ids or filter by campaign_id and/or created_from/created_to, with limit applied when using time/campaign filters. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if client_id is missing/invalid, if event_ids is empty, if created_from is after created_to, or if limit is outside the allowed range; raises NOT_FOUND if the client does not exist or any provided event_ids do not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to manage the client’s webhook history, and CONFLICT if a selected event is not in a failed state or has already been re-queued/processed and therefore cannot be retriggered.

client_id.description: Client ID that owns the failed publish events.

campaign_id.description: Optional campaign ID to retrigger failures for a single campaign.

event_ids.description: Specific failed webhook publish event record IDs to retrigger.

created_from.description: Retrigger failed events created at or after this timestamp.

created_to.description: Retrigger failed events created at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of failed events to retrigger when filtering by time/campaign.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_add_client
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new client record and returns the created client, including initial status and any provided white-label configuration. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is missing/blank, if status is not one of the supported values, or if whitelabel_config is provided when whitelabel_enabled is false. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to create clients, and CONFLICT if a client with the same identifying name already exists (as enforced by the system).

whitelabel_enabled.description: Whether white-labeling is enabled for the client.

whitelabel_config.description: White-label configuration object for the client.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_fetch_all_clients
tool_schemas.description: Lists clients in the system and returns a page of client records filtered by status and/or whitelabel_enabled, ordered by sort_by and sort_order; results are cursor-paginated using limit and cursor, and the response includes the next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sort_by/sort_order are invalid or if limit is outside the allowed range. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to view clients.

whitelabel_enabled.description: Filter clients by whether white-labeling is enabled.

limit.description: Maximum number of clients to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_vendors
tool_schemas.description: Lists domain vendors and returns a cursor-paginated page of vendor records (including IDs), optionally filtered by client_id visibility rules and vendor status; limit and cursor control pagination and the response includes the next cursor when applicable. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if status is invalid or limit is outside the allowed range. Raises NOT_FOUND if client_id is provided but does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to view vendors for the specified client/scope.

client_id.description: Client ID to scope vendor visibility (if applicable).

limit.description: Maximum number of vendors to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_search_domain
tool_schemas.description: Searches vendor inventory for domain suggestions matching the query and returns a cursor-paginated list of available domains, optionally constrained by max_price_usd and tld_allowlist (limit and cursor control pagination and a next cursor is returned when available). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if client_id/query are missing or invalid, if max_price_usd is not positive, if any TLD in tld_allowlist is malformed, or if limit is outside the allowed range. Raises NOT_FOUND if the client does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to perform searches for the client, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS if domain-search rate limits are exceeded.

client_id.description: Client id performing the domain search.

query.description: Domain name pattern or keyword to search for (e.g., brand name or partial domain).

max_price_usd.description: Maximum price in USD to include in results (defaults to 15 if omitted).

tld_allowlist.description: Optional list of allowed TLDs to filter results (e.g., ['.com','.io']).

limit.description: Maximum number of domain suggestions to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_auto_generate_mailboxes
tool_schemas.description: Generates a list of mailbox candidates for the given domain and identity details and returns the generated mailbox local-parts (and any associated display names if produced), up to mailbox_count. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any required field is missing/blank or mailbox_count is outside the allowed range. Raises NOT_FOUND if the client does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to generate mailboxes for the client, and CONFLICT if mailbox generation is not permitted for the requested domain (for example, when the domain format is not acceptable for provisioning).

client_id.description: Client id requesting mailbox generation.

domain.description: Domain name to generate mailboxes for (e.g., 'example.com').

first_name.description: First name used to generate mailbox local-parts.

last_name.description: Last name used to generate mailbox local-parts.

mailbox_count.description: Number of mailboxes to generate for the provided identity/domain.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_place_order_mailboxes
tool_schemas.description: Creates a procurement order for the specified domain and requested mailboxes with the selected vendor_record_id and returns the created order plus its initial fulfillment/procurement status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid, if mailboxes is empty, if any mailbox local_part is blank or duplicated within the request, or if vendor_record_id does not refer to a domain_vendor record. Raises NOT_FOUND if the client does not exist or the vendor record cannot be found, FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to place orders for the client, and CONFLICT if the domain/order cannot be placed due to current procurement state (e.g., already placed/fulfilled/cancelled) or if the vendor cannot accept the requested domain/mailbox combination.

client_id.description: Client id placing the procurement order.

domain.description: Domain to purchase as part of the order.

vendor_record_id.description: Record id of the selected domain vendor (integrations_and_procurement record_type='domain_vendor').

local_part.description: Mailbox local-part (before the @) to provision on the purchased domain.

display_name.description: Optional display name for the mailbox.

mailboxes.description: List of mailboxes to create/procure for the domain.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_domain_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists domains purchased through SmartSenders for the given client and returns a cursor-paginated page of domain procurement records, optionally filtered by status; limit and cursor control pagination and the response includes the next cursor when more results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if status is invalid or limit is outside the allowed range. Raises NOT_FOUND if the client does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to view the client’s procurement history.

client_id.description: Client id to retrieve purchased domains for.

status.description: Filter purchased domains by procurement status.

limit.description: Maximum number of domains to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of domains.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_list_clients
tool_schemas.description: Lists clients visible to the calling identity, optionally filtered by status/name; returns a paginated result set ordered by sort_by/sort_order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filters/pagination are invalid or unknown properties are provided; raises FORBIDDEN if not authorized.

limit.description: Maximum number of clients to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

include_deleted.description: When true, include deleted clients; otherwise deleted clients are excluded.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_client
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single client by client_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if client_id is malformed or unknown properties are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if no client exists with that ID. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the client.

client_id.description: Client ID to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_update_client_status
tool_schemas.description: Changes a client’s status to one of: active, suspended, or deleted, enforcing lifecycle transitions, and returns the updated client record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs are invalid or unknown properties are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the client does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to manage the client, and CONFLICT if the requested transition is not allowed.

client_id.description: Client ID to update.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_list_folders
tool_schemas.description: Lists Smart Delivery folders for a client, optionally filtered by status/name; returns a paginated result set. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if client_id/pagination are invalid or unknown properties are provided; raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the client.

client_id.description: Client ID that owns the folders.

limit.description: Maximum number of folders to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

include_deleted.description: When true, include deleted folders; otherwise deleted folders are excluded.

tool_schemas.name: smartlead_get_folder
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single Smart Delivery folder by folder_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if folder_id is malformed or unknown properties are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the folder does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the folder.
